
The progression is planned as:

| Project | Main learning objective |
| --- | --- |
| `min-char-rnn` | Learn next-character prediction using a recurrent hidden state. |
| `min-char-transformer` | Replace recurrence with causal self-attention and implement a complete, small Transformer from first principles. |
| `GPT-2 in R` | Build a deeper decoder-only Transformer with multiple blocks and attention heads, then explore tokenisation, larger-scale training and text generation. |
